q: How big is a tonne of CO2, in terms staff can picture?
title: What a tonne of CO2 looks like
short: At room temperature and normal pressure a tonne of CO2 fills about 556 cubic metres, a cube a little over 8 metres on each side. For a factory, it is about 373 litres of diesel burned, or about 1,408 kWh of grid electricity at India's 0.710 kg per kWh.
audience: Teams explaining carbon figures to staff

ul: Volume: about 556 cubic metres of gas at 25°C.

p: Staff remember a figure tied to their work, such as how many days of DG running make a tonne, better than a general comparison.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site, and labels estimates as estimates.

example.title: How the volume is worked out
lines: CO2 density at 25°C and 1 atm: about 1.80 kg per cubic metre
Cube root of 556: about 8.2 metres a side
